# Blasingame, Burch, Garrard & Ashley, P.C.

> A full-service Georgia law firm specializing in personal injury, real estate, business, and estate planning with offices in Athens and Lake Oconee.

BBGA is a prominent law firm serving Northeast Georgia with experienced attorneys recognized by Super Lawyers and Martindale-Hubbell. The firm provides comprehensive legal services to individuals and businesses across multiple practice areas.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Real Estate Law
- Business Law
- Estate Planning
- Medical Malpractice
- Nursing Home Abuse
- Corporate Transparency Act
- Georgia Attorneys
- Athens & Lake Oconee
- Legal Consultation
- Super Lawyers
- Business Formation & Compliance
- Real Estate Compliance
- Case Results
- Attorney Referrals
